newsitem.title: USA: Thrifty Payless stake held by Alpine group.
newsitem.headline: Thrifty Payless stake held by Alpine group.

text.p: A group led by Alpine Associates, a Cresskill, N.J., broker-dealer, said on Friday it has acquired a 5.88 percent stake in Thrifty Payless Holdings Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $54.6 million for 2,511,300 common shares of Thrifty Payless and holds the stake for investment as part of the ordinary course of its investment business.
The group said that since September 15, Alpine bought 2,454,400 shares of the Wilsonville, Ore.,-based drugstores chain for $53.4 million and has sold 52,000 shares for proceeds of $1,121,923.
Another group member, Palisades Partners L.P., an investment firm based in Nyack, N.Y., bought 107,900 shares during the same period for $2,305,378.
On October 14, Camp Hill, Pa.,-based Rite Aid Corp announced it had agreed acquire Thrifty Payless in a stock merger deal. Thrifty Payless is the largest drustore chain in western United States.
